schema.description: Request body for BFL FLUX 3 image generation and editing. A request with no images is a text-to-image generation; one to ten reference images make it an edit of, or a multi-reference generation from, those images. Bounding boxes have no field of their own: they ride at the end of the prompt text as a JSON array of {id, bbox, desc} rows for generation, or {id, from, src_bbox, tgt_bbox, desc} rows for an edit.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio: auto, 21:9, 2:1, 16:9, 3:2, 7:5, 4:3, 5:4, 1:1, 4:5, 3:4, 5:7, 2:3, 9:16, 1:2, or 9:21. auto follows the first reference image when one is present.

grounding.description: Let the model research the prompt with web search and image search before it generates. Set false to turn both off.

images.description: One to ten reference images the prompt edits or draws from, each an http(s) URL or a base64 string. A single string is treated as a one-item list. Each image must be at least 256x256 pixels and at most 16 megapixels, with a base64 payload at most 20 MB; inputs are resized to the closest resolution bin, up to 2k.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate, or of the edit to apply to the reference images.

safety_tolerance.description: Tolerance level for input and output moderation, 0 being most strict.

version.description: Endpoint version. latest serves the current release; dated pinnable release tags are added as they are published.
